# awx_notification_template_email (Resource)

Manages an AWX `Email` (`email`) notification template with first-class typed configuration attributes. Equivalent to `awx_notification_template` with `notification_type = "email"`, but with per-field schema validation and sensitivity instead of a JSON `notification_configuration` string.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_notification_template_email" "example" {
  name         = "Email"
  organization = awx_organization.typed.id
  host         = "smtp.example.com"
  port         = 587
  username     = "service-account"
  password     = var.secrets["email_password"]
  use_tls      = true
  use_ssl      = false
  sender       = "awx@example.com"
  recipients   = ["ops@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Host.
- `name` (String) Name of this notification template.
- `organization` (Number) Organization this notification template belongs to.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password.
- `port` (Number) Port.
- `recipients` (List of String) Recipient List.
- `sender` (String) Sender Email.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Use SSL.
- `use_tls` (Boolean) Use TLS.
- `username` (String) Username.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of this notification template.
- `messages` (String) Optional custom messages for this notification template, as a JSON object.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout. AWX defaults this to 30 when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Database ID of this notification template.
- `notification_type` (String) AWX notification type, fixed by this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <id>
import {
  to = awx_notification_template_email.example
  id = "1"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <id>
terraform import awx_notification_template_email.example 1
```
